summary: Inventory of packaged-verifier assertions that pin Learn review-packet packing (a/b/c) plus crew-instruction wording, role order and receipt counts. Only tests/verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs asserts packet-level structure; end-to-end Learn verifiers (figure-coverage, simple-learn, ui-contract) assert coverage/roster invariants that the (a) repacking must not break but that do not pin packet shape. No test asserts literal packet ids (`source:N`/`teaching:N`/`visual:N`). Change (c) additionally breaks the failure/timeout/checkpoint scenarios because their mock triggers are keyed to a source window starting at page 9.
architecture: Plan path: learn-review.ts planReviewAssignments -> reviewLearnDraft -> runReviewPass (review-layer.ts) -> prepared evidence + ModelRegistry.complete per packet; receipts are aggregated per role by aggregateReviews, so role order/count is independent of packet count. Unit verifier verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs imports learn-review.ts directly (planReviewAssignments/reviewLearnDraft/reviewOne) and is the only place packet ids, reads/views/cropIds, payload keys, batch progress, and complete-call counts are asserted. End-to-end verifiers drive tool-actions/learning.ts with a mock modelRegistry.complete and assert page/crop coverage and role roster only.

End-to-end Learn crew; asserts one receipt per role (3), requests>=3, and commit wording. Counts are role-level so packing changes do not break it.
End-to-end Learn flow on a 1-page section; prompt regexes 'Required read_source pages: 1.' / 'Required view_source pages: 1.' and commit wording.
Tutor-mode teaching review counting via planTutorExplanationPacket (different planner) - unaffected by (a)/(b)/(c).
